structure.unit: Payment of Fines and Costs on Installment Basis, Etc

law.catch_line: Requiring that defendant be of peace and good behavior until fine and costs are paid
law.text: If a defendant is permitted to pay a fine or fine and costs on an installment basis, or under such other conditions as the court shall fix under the provisions of § 19.2-354, the court may require as a condition that the defendant be of peace and good behavior until the fine and costs are paid.
